card.name: Linking words before vaccine types
card.fires_on: Small linking words, punctuation, or the start of 'inactivated' right after live, killed or inactivated vaccine terms, in warnings about vaccines for patients on immune-suppressing drugs.

modes.label: Between vaccine types
modes.description: An 'or', comma, or bracket joining live, killed or inactivated vaccine kinds.
modes.example: If inactivated viral<< or>> bacterial vaccines are administered to individuals receiving immun

modes.label: Inside 'inactivated'
modes.description: The middle of the word inactivated before influenza vaccine.
modes.example: Trivalent in<<activated>> influenza vaccine can be administered at any time

modes.label: Link before live vaccines
modes.description: A preposition just before the words live vaccines.
modes.example: Patients on Adalimumab-adaz may receive concurrent vaccinations, except<< for>> live vaccines.

card.writes: It lowers the odds of immune and immunity words coming next, so the text continues with vaccine type terms instead.
card.plain: It fires on the small words between kinds of vaccines, such as live or inactivated, in vaccine warnings.
